message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to remain outside B0100’s engagement geometry while retaining energy, first extending rapidly east at high altitude and then making a hard left lateral offset; B0100 remains well behind and below, while two high-altitude Team B missiles crossing behind are removed before or as the turn begins.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate the closing missile’s intercept while extending from B0100, using sustained descent and repeated high-bank heading changes without sacrificing speed; B01001 remains behind-left, descends toward its altitude, and closes, while B0100 stays behind rather than entering favorable attack geometry."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to remain outside B0100’s engagement geometry while retaining energy, first extending rapidly east at high altitude and then making a hard left lateral offset; B0100 remains well behind and below, while two high-altitude Team B missiles crossing behind are removed before or as the turn begins.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to complicate the closing missile’s intercept while extending from B0100, using sustained descent and repeated high-bank heading changes without sacrificing speed; B01001 remains behind-left, descends toward its altitude, and closes, while B0100 stays behind rather than entering favorable attack geometry.
